overview: Create 4 composable React primitives (SectionLabel, SectionHeading, SectionDescription, SectionIcon) and a server-only Markdown renderer as building blocks for page-builder sections. These follow a shadcn/ui composable pattern where layout lives in the consumer, not the atom. No Strapi schema — purely frontend atoms.
goals: Provide reusable, composable primitives for section-level content across all page-builder components
Eliminate layout coupling — each atom handles only its own rendering, consumers handle arrangement
Use existing design-system tokens (strapi-* colors, typography scale) for visual consistency
Follow shadcn/ui patterns already established in the codebase (CVA variants, data-slot, cn utility)
Provide a server-only Markdown renderer that uses typography atoms for consistent rendering
nonGoals: No Strapi schemas — these are React-only atoms
No layout/positioning logic inside atoms — consumers compose layout
No new Button variants — existing button.tsx already covers purple primary, blue primary, secondary blue outline, and ghost
No secondary green button variant (single-use edge case, deferred)
No page-builder section components in this scope — only the primitives
No syntax highlighting in Markdown renderer
No MDX support (no JSX in markdown)
No table or image rendering within markdown (deferred)
successMetrics: All 4 atoms are usable in isolation and composable together
Atoms use design-system tokens, not hardcoded colors or sizes
Markdown component is server-only — importing in a client component produces a build error
pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm build all pass
uiNotes: Use CVA only where variants are needed (SectionLabel color, SectionHeading textStyle)
Use design-system tokens: strapi-purple-600, strapi-green-600 for label colors; strapi-header-1 through strapi-small-2 for heading sizes; strapi-neutral-800 for dark text
Existing .typo-label class in design-system already defines the label pattern: text-strapi-small-1 font-semibold tracking-[0.5px] uppercase
SectionIcon accepts children (flexible — can be icon component, StrapiBasicImage, next/image, or any ReactNode)
SectionDescription renders plain text/ReactNode for now — consumers can pass Markdown component output as children
Markdown renderer is server-only (imports 'server-only') to avoid shipping react-markdown to client
Markdown heading renderers use SectionHeading atom for typography consistency
rules: Atoms must not import from page-builder components — dependency flows one way (page-builder → elementary)
Each atom must accept className prop for consumer overrides via cn() merge
SectionHeading separates semantic tag (as prop) from visual style (textStyle prop) — e.g., an h3 tag can look like an h1
SectionDescription renders children as ReactNode — no markdown parsing inside the atom itself
SectionIcon uses children pattern — no direct image rendering, consumers pass their own image component
Markdown component is server-only — use `import 'server-only'` at the top
Markdown links: external URLs get target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'

stories.title: Create SectionLabel atom
stories.description: As a developer, I want a SectionLabel component that renders small colored uppercase text used as a category label above headings (e.g., 'OUR VALUES', 'CAPABILITIES').
acceptanceCriteria: File created at apps/ui/src/components/elementary/SectionLabel.tsx

Renders as a

element by default
Accepts `as` prop to change element (p, span)
Uses CVA with color variant: 'purple' (default) mapping to text-strapi-purple-600, 'green' mapping to text-strapi-green-600
Applies the .typo-label pattern from design-system: text-strapi-small-1, font-semibold, tracking-[0.5px], uppercase
Accepts className prop merged via cn()
Accepts children as content
Includes data-slot='section-label' attribute
Example: <SectionLabel color='purple'>Our Values</SectionLabel> renders uppercase purple text
Example: <SectionLabel color='green'>Content Teams</SectionLabel> renders uppercase green text
Negative case: passing no color prop defaults to purple
pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint pass
stories.notes: Used Omit<HTMLAttributes, 'color'> to avoid TS conflict with native color attribute. Reuses .typo-label utility from design-system.

stories.title: Create SectionHeading atom
stories.description: As a developer, I want a SectionHeading component that renders heading text with independent semantic tag and visual text style.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at apps/ui/src/components/elementary/SectionHeading.tsx
Accepts `as` prop for HTML tag: 'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6', defaults to 'h2'

Accepts `textStyle` prop for visual size via CVA: 'display' (text-5xl+ or largest), 'h1' (text-strapi-header-1), 'h2' (text-strapi-header-2), 'h3' (text-strapi-header-3), 'subtitle1' (text-strapi-subtitle-1), 'subtitle2' (text-strapi-subtitle-2), defaults to matching the `as` prop
Applies font-bold and text-foreground (dark blue) by default
Applies tracking-tight for display and h1 sizes
Accepts className prop merged via cn()
Accepts children as content
Includes data-slot='section-heading' attribute
Example: <SectionHeading as='h1' textStyle='display'>Build websites</SectionHeading> renders h1 tag with display-size text
Example: <SectionHeading as='h3' textStyle='h1'>Visually large h3</SectionHeading> renders h3 tag styled as h1 size
Negative case: <SectionHeading as='h2' /> with no textStyle defaults to h2 visual size
pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint pass
stories.notes: Used tagToTextStyle mapping so omitting textStyle defaults to a style matching the `as` tag. h4 maps to subtitle1, h5/h6 map to subtitle2.

stories.title: Create SectionDescription atom
stories.description: As a developer, I want a SectionDescription component that renders body text for section descriptions. Accepts ReactNode children so consumers can pass plain text or pre-rendered Markdown output.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at apps/ui/src/components/elementary/SectionDescription.tsx
Accepts `children` as ReactNode content (plain text, or pre-rendered elements like Markdown output)
Applies text-strapi-body-1 size and text-muted-foreground color by default
Applies leading-relaxed for comfortable reading
Renders as a <div> with data-slot='section-description'
Accepts className prop merged via cn()
Example: <SectionDescription>Strapi gives developers full control.</SectionDescription> renders styled text
Negative case: no children / null renders nothing (returns null, no empty wrapper)
pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint pass

stories.title: Create SectionIcon atom
stories.description: As a developer, I want a SectionIcon component that wraps icon/image content with consistent sizing presets.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at apps/ui/src/components/elementary/SectionIcon.tsx
Accepts `children` as ReactNode — consumers pass their own image/icon (StrapiBasicImage, next/image, SVG, etc.)
Uses CVA with size variant: 'sm' (32px/size-8), 'md' (48px/size-12, default), 'lg' (64px/size-16)
Renders as a <div> wrapper with relative positioning and overflow-hidden
Applies [&_img]:object-contain to ensure child images scale properly within the size constraint
Accepts className prop merged via cn()
Includes data-slot='section-icon' attribute
Example: <SectionIcon size='lg'><Image src='/icon.svg' alt='' fill /></SectionIcon> renders 64px icon wrapper
Example: <SectionIcon><StrapiBasicImage component={iconData} fill /></SectionIcon> renders default 48px Strapi image wrapper
Negative case: no children renders an empty wrapper (no crash)
Negative case: size prop not provided defaults to 'md'
pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint pass

stories.title: Create base Markdown component with server-only enforcement
stories.description: As a developer, I want a server-only Markdown component that renders markdown strings using react-markdown with custom renderers mapped to typography atoms.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at apps/ui/src/components/elementary/markdown/Markdown.tsx
Imports 'server-only' at the top to prevent client bundling
Uses react-markdown to parse and render markdown
Accepts `children` prop as markdown string
Accepts `className` prop merged via cn() on the outer wrapper
Wraps output in a <div> with data-slot='markdown'
Returns null when children is falsy (empty string, undefined, null)
Custom heading renderers: h1-h6 map to SectionHeading with matching `as` and `textStyle` props, with appropriate bottom margin
Paragraphs: text-strapi-body-1, text-muted-foreground, leading-relaxed, margin-bottom
Bold: font-semibold text-foreground
Italic: italic style
Links: external URLs (http/https) get text-primary, underline, target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer'; internal links render without target='_blank'
Unordered lists: list-disc, pl-6, consistent spacing
Ordered lists: list-decimal, pl-6, consistent spacing
List items: text-strapi-body-1, text-muted-foreground
Blockquotes: border-l-4 border-strapi-purple-300, pl-4, italic, text-muted-foreground
Inline code: bg-muted, rounded, px-1.5, py-0.5, font-mono, text-sm
Code blocks: bg-muted, rounded-lg, p-4, font-mono, text-sm, overflow-x-auto (no syntax highlighting)
Example: <Markdown>{'Hello **world**'}</Markdown> renders paragraph with bold 'world'
Example: <Markdown>{'# Title\n\nSome text'}</Markdown> renders SectionHeading h1 + paragraph
Example: <Markdown>{'Visit [Strapi](https://strapi.io)'}</Markdown> renders link with target='_blank'
Example: <Markdown>{'- Item 1\n- Item 2'}</Markdown> renders bulleted list
Negative case: <Markdown>{''}</Markdown> returns null
Negative case: importing Markdown in a 'use client' component causes a build error
Negative case: deeply nested lists (3+ levels) render without breaking layout
pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint pass
